flags.old: Nib asks for nothing. He stands before his commander, head bowed.
flags.problem: The line has Nib standing before his commander with his head bowed, but the art shows him from behind beside the kneeling knight, head level and fists clenched, facing away into the hall while the knight faces the camera.
flags.new: Nib asks for nothing. He stands by his commander, small and still, fists clenched.

flags.old: Then the rewards: two Operator levels, stronger Link and Carry, and something called Route Alignment at thirty percent.
flags.problem: The line reads the on-screen reward log out as a four-item list (Operator, Link, Carry, Route Alignment) and adds only 'something called'; narr_echo scores it 0.46.
flags.new: Then the rewards. The two skills he leaned on tonight both level up, and something called Route Alignment climbs to thirty percent.

flags.old: His status holds a secret: his class is Operator, but others still see an F-rank summoner.
flags.problem: The line restates the status window item by item (class Operator, shown to others as an F summoner) with little added; narr_echo scores it 0.55, over the 0.5 rewrite line.
flags.new: His real class is Operator, and the system keeps it hidden. Everyone else will still see the same F-rank bait.

flags.old: He points his cup at Nib, wrapped in foil like a tiny burrito. Jaeha's cover story is weak.
flags.problem: The line says Choi points his cup at Nib, but the art has him holding the cup at his chest and smiling at Jaeha, with Nib wrapped in foil below Jaeha.
flags.new: Then Choi asks about Nib, wrapped in foil beside Jaeha like a tiny burrito. Jaeha's cover story is weak.

flags.old: Jaeha switches on his customer-service smile, and Nib does his very best impression of a doll.
flags.problem: Jaeha's grin and raised palms match, but Nib is drawn scowling with his eye turned sideways toward Choi, not blank like a doll.
flags.new: Jaeha switches on his customer-service smile, and Nib, very still in his foil, tries his best to pass for a husk.

flags.old: Then the billboard across the street lights up: Black Hound, live. Four dead, two missing, and the missing two are right here.
flags.problem: The first half reads the lower-third and ticker aloud in their own words and order (Black Hound, live, four dead, two missing), and only the last clause adds anything; narr_echo scores it 0.60.
flags.new: Across the street, the giant billboard lights up. Black Hound is already on air counting its losses, and two of them are sitting right here.
